{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Check how many of the completed orders have NaN revenue
nan_in_completed = completed_orders['revenue'].isnull().sum()

# Check the count of completed orders with valid revenue
valid_completed_count = len(completed_orders) - nan_in_completed

# Compute the mean revenue for completed orders with valid revenue
mean_revenue_completed = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

# Print results
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(completed_orders)}")
print(f"Number of completed orders with NaN revenue: {nan_in_completed}")
print(f"Number of completed orders with valid revenue: {valid_completed_count}")
print(f"Mean revenue (based on {valid_completed_count} valid orders): {mean_revenue_completed}")"}
